newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Comfort to distribute Malaysian cars.
newsitem.headline: Comfort to distribute Malaysian cars.

text.p: Comfort Group Ltd said on Wednesday it haD signed an agreement with Usaha Motors Pte Ltd to distribute Malaysian-made Perodua vehicles in Singapore.
Comfort, a taxi operator, said in a statement it would hold a 74-percent equity stake in the joint venture company, to be named Perocom Motors, with Usaha owning the remaining 26-percent stake.
Perocom Motors was incorporated on December 26, 1996, with an authorised share capital of Singapore $5 million and an initial paid-up capital of S$2 million, it said.
Perocom Motors would have sole Singapore distributorship rights to import, distribute, and resell Perodua vehicles, related spare parts and accessories, it added.
Perodua cars are Malaysia's second most popular domestically-made automobiles after the Proton.
